_about: LinkedIn example posts chosen by the chair. Nov 8, 2026: switched to "thank-you first" after the Bash recap: thank whoever ran it, one plain sentence on what was covered, the link, hashtags. No joke line, no headcounts.
page:
Thanks to everyone who came out to our first GBM of the year!

We went over this semester's projects, including a laptop built around an NVIDIA Jetson with IEEE UCF and Hack@UCF and an FPGA design competition.

#UCF #IEEE #EmbeddedSystems #FPGA

Thanks to Richard Hammingh and Ryan Zabatta for running our beginner's guide to Linux with FOSS @ UCF!

We went through picking a distro, installing it and getting comfortable using it day to day.

Slides: github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Beginners-Guide-to-Linux

#UCF #IEEE #SystemsProgramming

Thanks to everyone who came out to our intro to embedded systems workshop!

Everyone got an ESP32 and a breadboard and wrote code to drive outputs, read inputs and keep time.

Slides and setup: github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Intro-to-Embedded

#UCF #IEEE #EmbeddedSystems

Thanks to IEEE UCF for having our members help run their embedded systems workshop at Knight Hacks IX!

We helped hackers bring hardware into their weekend projects.

#UCF #IEEE #EmbeddedSystems

Thanks to Eren Siegman for leading our October GBM on GPU programming!

We wrote a first GPU kernel in HIP with CUDA alongside and learned how to tell whether code is limited by math or memory, with live demos on an AMD Instinct MI300X.

Slides and code: github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Intro-to-GPU-Kernels

#UCF #IEEE #GPU #HPC

Thanks to ACM, IEEE Women in Engineering and SPCB for co-hosting our Halloween social!

There was food, games and a costume contest. 🎃

#UCF #IEEE

Thanks to Richard Hammingh for running our intro to Bash workshop!

We went through variables, loops, functions and pipes, and wrote a script to clean up a Downloads folder.

Slides and code: github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Bash-Basics-Workshop

#UCF #IEEE #SystemsProgramming

Thanks to Derrick for running our intro to gem5!

We used the open-source simulator architects use to test processor designs before any silicon exists.

#UCF #IEEE #ComputerArchitecture
presenter: I ran an intro to Bash for IEEE Computer Society at UCF. We went through variables, loops, functions and pipes, and wrote a script to clean up a Downloads folder. Slides are at github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Bash-Basics-Workshop if you want to try it. Thanks to everyone who came!

I led an intro to GPU programming for IEEE Computer Society at UCF, with live demos on an AMD Instinct MI300X. We wrote a first kernel in HIP with CUDA alongside and looked at why most GPU code is limited by memory, not math. The slides and demos are at github.com/IEEECS-UCF/Intro-to-GPU-Kernels if you want to try it. Thanks to everyone who came!
